faq_a1: No. TalentRadar runs next to it and nothing moves. A list of companies from your CRM or a spreadsheet is enough. You download the new roles as a file to import into Bullhorn or Vincere, or as a generic CSV. There’s no direct ATS connection yet.
faq_a2: Not at all. Watching companies and roles needs no ATS. If you want one, every plan includes Radar + ATS: candidates, contacts, jobs, pipeline and placements. It’s deliberately simple, built for small agencies.
faq_a3: It reads roles from Jobs.cz and Teamio, from company ATS (Greenhouse, Lever, Workable, Ashby, SmartRecruiters, Workday, Personio, BambooHR, Teamtailor, Recruitee, Pinpoint, HireHive, Phenom, Jibe, SuccessFactors, Oracle Recruiting, Eightfold) and from ordinary career pages. Out of it you get Excel, a generic CSV and an import file for Bullhorn and Vincere. We connect unusual career pages on request in the Scale plan.
faq_a4: When the ad disappears from the site, the next scan notices, the one after confirms it, and TalentRadar archives the role. A careers page that’s briefly down won’t wipe your list. If the company posts the role again, it comes back with its history and notes.
faq_a5: The trial lasts 14 days, with no credit card, the features of the Agency Pro plan and up to 150 companies. The first 5 agencies get the first month free instead, then 3 months at half price. Three days before the end you get an e-mail. If you want to carry on, you pick a plan in the app and I send you an invoice. The trial never turns into a paid plan by itself.
faq_a6: No. When you search for a candidate you only paste the profile, and once you’ve searched it’s gone. Before anything goes to the AI we take out the name, e-mail, phone and links. Candidates are stored only if you add them yourself in Radar + ATS.
faq_a7_html: TalentRadar is run by its founder, Kryštof Pejša, who is also the controller of personal data. Every agency has its own separate database and sees only its own data. Who helps us run the website and the form, and how long we keep the data, is set out in our privacy policy.
faq_a8: We read only what companies publish for job seekers themselves: public career pages and public ATS APIs. We don’t read LinkedIn automatically; you open the search link yourself.

how_ch1_body_m: Scans run at 6:00 and 12:00. AI sets roles outside your specialisation aside by your rules; they stay available.

how_ch2_body: The reason is a fresh role, a role open for 45+ days, or a company you haven’t spoken to in a while. From the posting we estimate who most likely decides on the hire, and one click looks for them on LinkedIn or Google. The draft is in your own style, and you send it yourself.

proof_story: It started at an agency in Dublin: over two months the radar watched 180 companies there and caught more than 3,400 open roles.
story_body_html: In Dublin I worked at Ingenio Global, the recruitment agency run by Rob Magee. Every Monday morning, experienced headhunters there went through clients’ career pages and copied links into spreadsheets. So I wrote a system that does it by itself. For the next two months it ran in production: it watched 180 companies and caught more than 3,400 open roles. That system is now TalentRadar. When you get in touch, you deal with me directly.
story_h2: Built inside an agency, for agencies
story_short_m: In Dublin I watched experienced headhunters go through clients’ career pages every Monday and copy links into spreadsheets. I wrote a system that does it by itself: over two months it followed 180 companies and caught more than 3,400 open roles. Today it is TalentRadar.
trial_ai_brief:
Prepare a company list for TalentRadar, a service that tracks where companies are hiring.

Source: [attach a CRM export or your client list, or describe the sectors and region we care about]

Return only the table as plain text, with no introduction, no comment and no code block. At most 150 rows. The separator is a semicolon. The first row must be exactly:
Company;Careers page;Last contact;Had placement

Rules:
- Company: the company name, each company only once.
- Careers page: the address of its open positions page, only if you know it for certain. Otherwise leave it empty, we will look it up. Do not make up addresses.
- Last contact: the date of the last contact with the company as 15/03/2024, only if it is in the source. Otherwise empty.
- Had placement: yes or no, only if the source says so. Otherwise empty.
- Do not include people's names, emails, phone numbers or candidates.

Example:
Company;Careers page;Last contact;Had placement
Air Bank;airbank.cz/careers;15/03/2024;yes
Rohlik Group;;;
